![](https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/analogdevicesinc/system-level/wiki_migration/eval-ade120x_landing/docs/solutions/reference-designs/eval-ade120x/eval-ade1202.png)

The ADE120x is an isolated binary input monitor. It performs an isolated
measurement of a binary input voltage and communicates the status of this input
to low voltage processors or logic circuits. The ADE120x application circuit
can accept a wide range of binary input voltages from 10 V to 300 V sc
